note: Zone of R_harbour_01: the end of the stone breakwater, camera on the breakwater facing the open sea; landmark: the red-and-white lighthouse with its beam. marin (adj) LEFT: sea turtle swimming, a crab running along the stones to keep up. Masculine RIGHT: mouse captain sailing a tiny vessel in a puddle (vaisseau), steamship veering round a duck (navire), lighthouse (phare), crew lined up on deck with the page holding a key (équipage), little car ferry with a student and backpack (bac). Exit: fingerpost near left -> back along the breakwater to R_harbour_01. Painted 2026-10-22.
